title: Il posto migliore dove alloggiare: l'ordine degli aggettivi

sentences.it: Abbiamo soggiornato in un grande albergo moderno e costoso.
sentences.en: We stayed in an expensive large modern hotel.
alternatives: We stayed in an expensive big modern hotel.
sentences.hint: past simple + ordine degli aggettivi: opinione, dimensione, età — stay, hotel, expensive, large, modern

sentences.it: Ho comprato un bel tavolo di legno rotondo.
sentences.en: I bought a beautiful round wooden table.
alternatives: I bought a nice round wooden table.
I've bought a beautiful round wooden table.
sentences.hint: past simple + ordine degli aggettivi: opinione, forma, materiale — buy, beautiful, round, wooden, table

sentences.it: Mia nonna ha una vecchia borsa di pelle italiana.
sentences.en: My grandmother has an old Italian leather bag.
alternatives: My grandma has an old Italian leather bag.
My grandmother has got an old Italian leather bag.
sentences.hint: ordine degli aggettivi: età, origine, materiale — grandmother, old, Italian, leather, bag

sentences.it: Mi serve un sacco a pelo blu.
sentences.en: I need a blue sleeping bag.
sentences.hint: need + colore prima del nome composto — blue, sleeping bag

sentences.it: Abbiamo visto una bellissima piccola chiesa greca.
sentences.en: We saw a beautiful small Greek church.
alternatives: We saw a beautiful little Greek church.
sentences.hint: past simple + ordine degli aggettivi: opinione, dimensione, origine — see, beautiful, small, Greek, church

sentences.it: Hai mai soggiornato in un ostello?
sentences.en: Have you ever stayed in a hostel?
sentences.hint: present perfect con ever — stay, hostel

sentences.it: Qual è il tuo tipo di alloggio preferito e perché?
sentences.en: What is your favourite type of accommodation and why?
alternatives: What's your favourite type of accommodation and why?
What is your favorite type of accommodation and why?
What's your favorite type of accommodation and why?
Which is your favourite type of accommodation and why?
sentences.hint: domanda con what is + favourite — type of accommodation, why

sentences.it: Le camere sono piccole ma pulite e comode.
sentences.en: The rooms are small but clean and comfortable.
sentences.hint: present simple + but, and — rooms, small, clean, comfortable

sentences.it: L'albergo ha una piccola piscina rettangolare all'aperto.
sentences.en: The hotel has a small rectangular outdoor pool.
alternatives: The hotel has a small, rectangular outdoor pool.
The hotel has a small rectangular outdoor swimming pool.
sentences.hint: ordine degli aggettivi: dimensione, forma, tipo — small, rectangular, outdoor, pool

sentences.it: Non è un albergo di lusso, ma è tranquillo ed elegante.
sentences.en: It's not a luxury hotel, but it's quiet and stylish.
alternatives: It isn't a luxury hotel, but it's quiet and stylish.
It is not a luxury hotel, but it is quiet and stylish.
sentences.hint: it's not + but — luxury hotel, quiet, stylish

sentences.it: C'è il Wi-Fi gratuito e una scrivania se devi lavorare.
sentences.en: There is free Wi-Fi and a desk if you need to work.
alternatives: There's free Wi-Fi and a desk if you need to work.
There is free Wi-Fi and a desk if you have to work.
There's free Wi-Fi and a desk if you have to work.
sentences.hint: there is + if — free Wi-Fi, desk, need, work

sentences.it: La piscina è perfetta per rinfrescarsi dopo una giornata impegnativa.
sentences.en: The pool is perfect to cool down after a busy day.
alternatives: The pool is perfect for cooling down after a busy day.
sentences.hint: perfect + to — pool, cool down, after, busy day

sentences.it: È perfetto per i giovani che non vogliono spendere troppi soldi.
sentences.en: It's perfect for young people who don't want to spend too much money.
alternatives: It is perfect for young people who don't want to spend too much money.
It is perfect for young people who do not want to spend too much money.
sentences.hint: perfect for + who — young people, spend, too much money

sentences.it: Il villaggio turistico ha una grande piscina blu.
sentences.en: The resort has a large blue pool.
alternatives: The resort has a big blue pool.
The resort has a large blue swimming pool.
The resort has a big blue swimming pool.
sentences.hint: present simple + dimensione prima del colore — resort, large, blue, pool

vocabulary.example: We found cheap accommodation near the beach.
vocabulary.mnemonic: Pensa ad "accomodarsi": l'alloggio è il posto dove ti accomodi. Si scrive con due c e due m.

vocabulary.example: What accommodation type do you prefer?
We spent a week at a beach resort.
Students often stay in a hostel because it's cheap.
vocabulary.mnemonic: Non confonderlo con "hotel": l'hostel ha una s in più ed è l'ostello, più economico.

vocabulary.example: We stopped at a motel on the highway.
We slept in a lodge in the mountains.
The hostel is popular with young travellers.
We stayed at a small hotel by the sea.
vocabulary.mnemonic: Falso amico: "stay" vuol dire restare, soggiornare, non "stare" nel senso di sentirsi.

vocabulary.example: This is my favourite hotel in Rome.
Adjective order in English is quite strict.
In my opinion, the resort is too expensive.
The pool has a strange shape.
vocabulary.mnemonic: Pensa a "in shape", in forma: shape è la forma di un oggetto.

vocabulary.example: What colour is your bag?
The origin of the word is Greek.
What material is this jacket made of?
The purpose of the trip was to relax.
vocabulary.mnemonic: Pensa a "proporsi": lo scopo è ciò che ti proponi di fare.

vocabulary.example: We stayed in an old stone house.
There is a square table in the kitchen.
We had dinner at a round wooden table.
vocabulary.mnemonic: Pensa a "rotondo": anche "round" comincia con la r.

vocabulary.example: The room had a rectangular window.
The hotel has a blue swimming pool.
We ate at a lovely Greek restaurant.
Please don't use plastic bags.
The cabin has a big wooden table.
vocabulary.mnemonic: Viene da "wood", il legno: "wooden" vuol dire fatto di legno.

vocabulary.example: He bought a brown leather bag.
vocabulary.mnemonic: Non confonderlo con "letter" (lettera): leather, con la th, è la pelle di scarpe e borse.

vocabulary.example: Don't forget your sleeping bag when you go camping.
I left my bag in the hotel room.
There is an old church in the village.
The resort has a large outdoor pool.
They stayed in a luxury hotel in Dubai.
vocabulary.mnemonic: Falso amico: "luxury" vuol dire lusso, non "lussuria".

vocabulary.example: She always wears stylish clothes.
vocabulary.mnemonic: Contiene "style": chi è stylish ha stile.

vocabulary.example: The room was simple but clean.
There is a desk by the window.
vocabulary.mnemonic: Pensa a "desco", la vecchia parola italiana per tavola.

vocabulary.example: The hostel offers free Wi-Fi to all guests.
After the walk we cooled down in the pool.
I had a busy day at work.
vocabulary.mnemonic: Si scrive con la u ma si legge "bisi".

vocabulary.example: The flats are popular with young professionals.
We spent too much money on holiday.
vocabulary.mnemonic: Falso amico: "spend" vuol dire spendere soldi, ma anche passare il tempo (spend a day).

vocabulary.example: I don't have much money left.

grammar.title: L'ordine degli aggettivi
grammar.body:
In inglese gli aggettivi vanno **prima del nome**, e quando sono più di uno seguono un **ordine preciso**:

| Ordine | Esempio |
| --- | --- |
| 1. opinione (*opinion*) | *beautiful* |
| 2. dimensione (*size*) | *large* |
| 3. età (*age*) | *old* |
| 4. forma (*shape*) | *square* |
| 5. colore (*colour*) | *blue* |
| 6. origine (*origin*) | *Greek* |
| 7. materiale (*material*) | *plastic* |
| 8. scopo (*purpose*) | *sleeping* |

- *We stayed in an **expensive large modern** hotel.* — opinione, dimensione, età.
- *The hotel has a **small, rectangular outdoor** pool.* — dimensione, forma, scopo.
- *a **beautiful round wooden** table* — opinione, forma, materiale.

In italiano l'ordine è spesso al contrario e gli aggettivi stanno anche dopo il nome: "un tavolo di legno rotondo" diventa *a round wooden table*.

L'aggettivo di **scopo** è quasi parte del nome e sta sempre per ultimo: *sleeping bag* (sacco a pelo), *swimming pool*.
